Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** ON WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 13TH, WHILE ASSESSING NEWLY ACQUIRED ASSETS, A SMALL PACKING RELEASE WAS DISCOVERED ON A VALVE. SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 33.748995, -84.387982 (Approximated from locality)
Reported Spill Volume: 1700 gallon
Report DescriptionUPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1297761: CALLER REPORTED THERE WERE 14 ADDITIONAL RAIL CARS THAT DERAILED AT THE INCIDENT SITE"S CLASS YARD. THE ORIGINAL SET OF DERAILED RAIL CARS AND LOCOMOTIVES DERAILED IN THE RECEIVING YARD. CALLER PROVIDED IDENTIFICATION OF THE ORIGINAL DERAILED RAIL CARS, LOCOMOTIVE, AND ADDITIONAL RAIL CARS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS INCIDENT. CALLER STATED THE RAIL CARS WITH CONTENTS DID NOT RELEASE ANY MATERIALS. NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES WERE REPORTED. THE CAUSE OF THE DERAILMENT IS STILL UNDER INVESTIGATION. ORIGINAL REPORT IS BELOW: CALLER REPORTED A FREIGHT TRAIN SHOVED A CUT OF CARS AT A RAIL YARD TRACK (RT2) AND RAN OVER A DRAWHEAD AT THE TRACK (RT2) CAUSING THREE RAIL CARS AND THREE LOCOMOTIVES TO DERAIL. TWO OF THE DERAILED LOCOMOTIVES HAD PUNCTURED FUEL TANKS WHICH CAUSED A RELEASE OF DIESEL FUEL ON THE BALLAST OF THE RAIL YARD. THERE WERE NO IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS KNOWN FOR THE ONE OF THE LOCOMOTIVES AND FOR THE THREE DERAILED RAIL CARS. THERE WERE NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES WITH THIS INCIDENT.

Report Description
SOLDIERS FROM A VESSEL IN THE 3RD PORT OPERATIONS FACILITY, FORT EUSTIS VA. HAD COMPLETED DISCHARGING BILGE WATER, AND WERE UNCOUPLING THE HOSE WHEN THEY ENCOUNTERED UNEXPECTED PRESSURE IN THE DISCHARGE LINE. THE PRESSURE CAUSED THE OPERATOR TO DISCHARGE APPROXIMATELY FIVE GALLONS OF BILGE WATER ONTO THE PIER, WITH APPROXIMATELY ONE GALLON ENTERING THE WATERS OF SKIFFES CREEK. IN ACCORDANCE WITH SOPS THE VESSEL HAD UTILIZED CONTAINMENT BOOM BEFORE OPERATIONS BEGAN. ALL CONTAMINATION WAS CONTAINED INSIDE THE BOOM, AND CREWS ARE CONDUCTING CLEAN UP OPERATIONS.
